description: Only transactions with an amount of 2400 or more count, so an amount of exactly 2400 is included.

a.request: Considering only transactions whose amount (`trans.amount`) is at least 2400, group them by operation (`trans.operation`), with transactions that have no operation forming their own group. For each group, show the operation; the average signed amount, where the amount counts as positive for credits (`trans.type` = 'PRIJEM'), as negative for withdrawals (`trans.type` = 'VYDAJ'), and is left out of the average for any other type; and the total number of transactions in the group, of any type.
a.sql:
SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS average_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans
WHERE amount >= 2400
GROUP BY operation;

c.request: Treating 2400 as the cutoff for a large transaction amount (`trans.amount`), break the large transactions down by operation (`trans.operation`), with transactions that have no operation as their own group. For each group, show the operation; the average signed amount, positive for credits (`trans.type` = 'PRIJEM') and negative for withdrawals ('VYDAJ'), with any other type left out of the average; and how many large transactions the group has in total, of any type. Only transactions with an amount of 2400 or more count, so an amount of exactly 2400 is included.
c.sql: SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS average_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400 GROUP BY operation;

d.request: Group transactions with `trans.amount >= 2400` by `trans.operation`, treating NULL operation as its own group; show each operation, the average signed amount for rows whose `trans.type` is `PRIJEM` or `VYDAJ` (credits positive, withdrawals negative), and the total number of qualifying transactions of any type in the group.
d.sql: SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400 GROUP BY operation

b.request: Group transactions with trans.amount ≥ 2400 by trans.operation, treating NULL operation as its own group; for each group, show the operation, the average signed amount using only PRIJEM (positive) and VYDAJ (negative) transactions, and the total count of transactions of any type.
b.sql:
SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS average_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans
WHERE amount >= 2400
GROUP BY operation;
